summary: All ten Scripture quotes are KJV-verbatim and the Christ-as-the-one-door type with its grace-anchored, fear-free CTA is doctrinally sound; the only error is a dimensional one — the 300 cubits is described as the ark's vertical height when Gen 6:15 makes it the length (height was 30 cubits).

findings.quote_or_claim: Three hundred cubits it climbed into the sky on dry land — a mountain of timber where no sea had ever rolled
findings.problem: The phrase 'climbed into the sky' attributes the 300-cubit measurement to the ark's vertical height. Gen 6:15 makes 300 cubits the LENGTH of the ark; the height was only thirty cubits and the breadth fifty. Describing the ark as towering 300 cubits into the sky inverts the dimension given in the source text.
findings.proposed_fix_text: Three hundred cubits it stretched across the dry land — a mountain of timber where no sea had ever rolled — and the people came to gawk at the madman and his boat.
